question: How is the Lord of Serpents honored under the name Cakreśa?
premises: Obeisance is offered to one named Cakreśa.
The same deity is addressed as Lord of Serpents.
The salutation is repeated for reverence.
inference: Nāgeśa is revered under the designation Cakreśa.
plain_english: Obeisance to the one named Cakreśa, obeisance, obeisance to Nāgeśa.
